class TheEntryPoint(Case):
    """main() with the agents replaced: no answer exits cleanly, an answer is submitted."""

    async def start(self, environment, answer=None):
        async def solve(task, playwright):  # the agents attach to the run's browsers themselves
            self.seen = (task, hasattr(playwright, "chromium"))
            return answer

        out = io.StringIO()
        env = {"SystemRoot": os.environ["SystemRoot"], **environment} if "SystemRoot" in os.environ else environment
        with patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True), patch.object(agent, "solve", solve), redirect_stdout(out):
            code = await agent.main()
        return code, out.getvalue()

    async def test_without_an_answer_it_exits_cleanly(self):
        api = self.serve({"/v1/runs/current": [(200, RUN)]})
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_API_URL": api.url, "CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN": "rt_secret"})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.seen, (RUN, True))
        self.assertIn("No answer to submit", out)
        self.assertEqual([request["method"] for request in api.requests], ["GET"])
        self.assertNotIn("REDACTED", out)

    async def test_an_answer_is_submitted_once(self):
        api = self.serve({"/v1/runs/current/answer": [(202, {"status": "accepted"})]})
        api.replies["/v1/runs/current"] = [(200, {**RUN, "submission": {
            "kind": "api", "url": api.url + "/v1/runs/current/answer"}})]
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_API_URL": api.url, "CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN": "rt_secret"}, {"bid": 1})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("HTTP 202", out)
        self.assertEqual(api.requests[-1]["body"], {"bid": 1})

    async def test_locally_the_answer_is_printed_not_submitted(self):
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_SCOUTING": json.dumps(RUN)}, {"bid": 1})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn('{"bid": 1}', out)
        self.assertIn("local", out)

def a_bid(**changes) -> Bid:
    material = Material(number="M-1", bore_mm=50, stroke_mm=200, pressure_bar=160, mounting="flange",
                        certification="none")
    priced = Line("1", "M-1", 40, unit_price=Decimal("12.50"), lead_time_weeks=3, base_unit_price=Decimal("12.00"),

    for name, value in changes.items():

class FakeTab:
    """As much of a Tab as the agent loop touches; it records the actions it was given."""

    def __init__(self, site_id: str):
        self.site_id, self.base_url = site_id, f"http://{site_id}.test"
        self.page = SimpleNamespace(url=self.base_url + "/start", main_frame=self)
        self.document, self.document_source, self.done = "", "", []

    async def evaluate(self, script):
        return True

    async def observe(self) -> str:
        return f"url: {self.page.url}\ntitle: {self.site_id}\n[1] button \"go\""

    def take_events(self) -> list[str]:
        return []

    async def click(self, aid) -> str:
        self.done.append(("click", aid))
        return f"clicked [{aid}]"

    async def fill(self, aid, text, enter=False) -> str:
        self.done.append(("fill", aid, text))
        return f"filled [{aid}]"


class Script:
    """Stands in for llm.chat_json: answers each agent, named by `label`, with its next scripted reply."""

    def __init__(self, **replies):
        self.replies, self.asked = replies, []

    async def __call__(self, messages, *, think=True, max_tokens=6000, label=""):
        self.asked.append({"label": label, "think": think, "system": messages[0]["content"],
                           "user": messages[-1]["content"]})
        return self.replies[label].pop(0) if self.replies.get(label) else {}

    def turns(self, label: str) -> list[dict]:
        return [call for call in self.asked if call["label"] == label]


def done(**fields) -> dict:
    return {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "done", **fields}]}

class FakeServer:
    """One HTTP server for the API and the models: answers each request with the next scripted reply per path."""

    def __init__(self, replies: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict]]]):
        self.replies, self.requests = replies, []
        fake = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

            def handle_one(self):
                length = int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)
                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)) if length else None
                # self.headers matches header names in any case: urllib sends X-api-key
                fake.requests.append({"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "headers": self.headers,
                                      "body": body})
                status, reply = fake.replies[self.path].pop(0)
                data = json.dumps(reply).encode()
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)

            do_GET = do_POST = handle_one

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()


class Case(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):

        server = FakeServer(replies)
        self.addCleanup(server.close)
        return server

                    candidate = candidates.nth(index)
                    try:
                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]
                        if label == info["name"] and (await candidate.evaluate("el => el.tagName")) == info["tag"] \
                                and not await candidate.evaluate("el => el.disabled === true"):
                            control = candidate
                            break
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        continue
                if control:
                    break
            if control is None:
                break
            try:
                await control.click(timeout=2500)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                try:
                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
            await self.read()
            if self.document in seen:
                break
            seen.add(self.document)
            pages.append(self.document)
        if len(pages) == 1:
            return f'"{info["name"]}" led to no further page; the list is the page you see'
        grows = len(pages) > 1 and all(later.startswith(pages[0][:200]) and len(later) >= len(earlier)
                                       for earlier, later in zip(pages, pages[1:])) and info["tag"] != "A"
        if grows:  # a "load more" control: the last page holds every row
            self.document = pages[-1]
            return f'followed "{info["name"]}" {len(pages) - 1} time(s); the list is now complete on the page'
        self.document = "\n".join(f"{PAGE_BREAK} {number} =====\n{page}" for number, page in enumerate(pages, 1))
        return (f'followed "{info["name"]}" through {len(pages)} page(s); you are on the last one. COLLECTED DOCUMENT '
                f"(file it with keep if it is relevant):\n{without_ids(self.document)[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

    async def fetch(self, aid) -> str:
        """Download what the chosen link points to and read it as a document."""
        locator = self._locator(aid)
        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
        target = await locator.evaluate("el => el.href || el.src || el.getAttribute('data-url') || el.getAttribute('formaction') || ''")
        if not target:
            return f"[{aid}] has no address to download"
        target = urljoin(self.page.url, target)
        if not self._on_site(target):
            return f"{target} is not on this website"
        try:
            response = await self.page.context.request.get(target, timeout=20000)
            data = await response.body()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"could not download {target}: {str(error)[:150]}"
        name = urlparse(target).path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] or "download"
        disposition = response.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
        named = re.search(r'filename\*?=(?:UTF-8\'\')?"?([^";]+)', disposition)
        if named:
            name = named.group(1)
        self.document = document_text(data, response.headers.get("content-type", ""), name)
        self.document_source = target
        return (f"downloaded {name} (HTTP {response.status}, {len(data)} bytes). DOCUMENT (file it with keep if it is "
                f"relevant):\n{self.document[:MAX_OBSERVATION * 2]}")

    async def close_popup(self, tab: Tab, page: str) -> None:
        """What a model does about a popup the page still shows: press its close button, the first one listed."""
        if await self.popup_open(tab):
            close = [control for control in controls(page) if control.kind == "button" and control.name in ("×", "Close")]
            self.assertTrue(close, f"the popup is open, but no button closes it in:\n{page}")
            await tab.click(close[0].id)
        self.assertFalse(await self.popup_open(tab), f"the popup is still open after:\n{page}")

    async def add_to_basket(self, tab: Tab) -> None:
        """The page behind the popup works again."""
        page = await tab.observe()
        self.assertNotIn("sign me up", page)
        self.assertNotIn("Send my answer", page)
        await tab.click(self.control(page, "button", "Add Widget A").id)
        self.assertIn("Basket: 1 Widget A", await tab.observe())

    async def test_a_popup_that_opened_by_itself_is_reported_and_gone_without_following_its_link(self):
        tab = await self.open("/timed_dialog.html")
        await self.popup_opens(tab)
        page = await tab.observe()
        self.assertIn("Newsletter", page + "\n".join(tab.take_events()))
        await self.close_popup(tab, page)
        await self.add_to_basket(tab)
        self.assertTrue(tab.page.url.endswith("/timed_dialog.html"), tab.page.url)
        self.assertNotIn("/arrived/newsletter", SITE.paths)

    async def test_a_popup_that_asks_something_is_shown_and_its_close_button_closes_it(self):
        tab = await self.open("/timed_dialog_question.html")
        await self.popup_opens(tab)
        page = await tab.observe()
        self.assertIn("Quick question", page + "\n".join(tab.take_events()))
        await self.close_popup(tab, page)
        await self.add_to_basket(tab)
        self.assertTrue(tab.page.url.endswith("/timed_dialog_question.html"), tab.page.url)
        self.assertNotIn("/arrived/survey", SITE.paths)

    async def test_a_popup_that_opens_after_the_page_was_read_does_not_swallow_the_next_actions_unnoticed(self):
        tab = await self.open("/timed_dialog.html?after=1500")
        page = await tab.observe()
        self.assertFalse(await self.popup_open(tab), "test setup: the popup opened before the page was read")
        remark, add = self.control(page, "input", "Remark"), self.control(page, "button", "Add Widget A")
        await self.popup_opens(tab)

        said = await tab.fill(remark.id, "two boxes")
        held = await tab.page.input_value("#remark")
        self.assertTrue(held == "two boxes" or not said.startswith("filled"),
                        f'fill answered "{said}", but the field holds "{held}"')
        said = await tab.click(add.id)
        basket = await tab.page.inner_text("#basket")
        self.assertTrue(basket == "Basket: 1 Widget A" or not said.startswith("clicked"),
                        f'click answered "{said}", but the page says "{basket}"')

        page = await tab.observe()
        self.assertIn("Newsletter", page + "\n".join(tab.take_events()))

import sys

import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

import llm  # noqa: E402
import submit  # noqa: E402
from calculator import Bid, Line, Material  # noqa: E402

CONTEXT = {"tender_reference": "T-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-03-01T09:00:00+00:00", "company": "Example Works",
           "vat_id": "XX000000001", "email": "sales@bidder.example"}


def a_bid(**changes) -> Bid:
    material = Material(number="M-1", bore_mm=50, stroke_mm=200, pressure_bar=160, mounting="flange",
                        certification="none")
    priced = Line("1", "M-1", 40, unit_price=Decimal("12.50"), lead_time_weeks=3, base_unit_price=Decimal("12.00"),
                  surcharge_per_unit=Decimal("0.50"), packaging_per_unit=Decimal("0"), rebate_total=None,
                  material=material)
    bid = Bid("T-0001", "bid", Decimal("2.5"), [priced], Decimal("500.00"), omitted=["2"])
    for name, value in changes.items():
        setattr(bid, name, value)
    return bid


class FakeTab:
    """As much of a Tab as the agent loop touches; it records the actions it was given."""

    def __init__(self, site_id: str):
        self.site_id, self.base_url = site_id, f"http://{site_id}.test"
        self.page = SimpleNamespace(url=self.base_url + "/start", main_frame=self)
        self.document, self.document_source, self.done = "", "", []

    async def evaluate(self, script):
        return True

    async def observe(self) -> str:
        return f"url: {self.page.url}\ntitle: {self.site_id}\n[1] button \"go\""

    def take_events(self) -> list[str]:
        return []

    async def click(self, aid) -> str:
        self.done.append(("click", aid))
        return f"clicked [{aid}]"

    async def fill(self, aid, text, enter=False) -> str:
        self.done.append(("fill", aid, text))
        return f"filled [{aid}]"


class Script:
    """Stands in for llm.chat_json: answers each agent, named by `label`, with its next scripted reply."""

    def __init__(self, **replies):
        self.replies, self.asked = replies, []

    async def __call__(self, messages, *, think=True, max_tokens=6000, label=""):
        self.asked.append({"label": label, "think": think, "system": messages[0]["content"],
                           "user": messages[-1]["content"]})
        return self.replies[label].pop(0) if self.replies.get(label) else {}

    def turns(self, label: str) -> list[dict]:
        return [call for call in self.asked if call["label"] == label]


def done(**fields) -> dict:
    return {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "done", **fields}]}

class EnteringTheBid(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):

    async def test_the_signing_code_comes_from_an_agent_on_the_mailbox(self):
        script = Script(
            submit=[{"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "the code I requested just now"}]},
                    {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "fill", "id": 1, "text": "CODE-7"}, {"do": "click", "id": 1}]},
                    done(answer="R-1", summary="received")],

        result, tender = await self.run_with(script)
        courier = script.turns("courier")[0]
        self.assertIn("http://mail.test", courier["system"])
        self.assertIn("T-0001", courier["system"])
        self.assertIn("the code I requested just now", courier["user"])
        self.assertIn('the mailbox colleague answers: "CODE-7"', script.turns("submit")[1]["user"])
        self.assertIn(("fill", 1, "CODE-7"), tender.done)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"submitted": True, "receipt": "R-1", "notes": "received"})

    async def test_a_code_that_was_handed_out_is_not_handed_out_again(self):
        ask = {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "a fresh code"}]}
        script = Script(submit=[ask, ask, done(answer="R-1")], courier=[done(answer="CODE-1"), done(answer="CODE-2")])
        await self.run_with(script)
        first, second = script.turns("courier")
        self.assertNotIn("CODE-1", first["user"])
        self.assertIn("- CODE-1", second["user"])
        self.assertIn("Codes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: CODE-1, CODE-2", script.turns("submit")[2]["user"])

    async def test_the_clerk_hears_when_the_mailbox_has_nothing(self):
        ask = {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "the code"}]}
        script = Script(submit=[ask, done(summary="no code")], courier=[done(summary="no such message")])
        result, _ = await self.run_with(script)
        self.assertIn("the mailbox colleague found nothing: no such message", script.turns("submit")[1]["user"])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"submitted": False, "receipt": "", "notes": "no code"})

    async def test_without_a_mailbox_in_the_run_the_clerk_is_told_so(self):
        ask = {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "the code"}]}
        script = Script(submit=[ask, done(summary="cannot sign")])
        result, _ = await self.run_with(script, mail_tab=None)
        self.assertIn("there is no mailbox in this run", script.turns("submit")[1]["user"])
        self.assertEqual(script.turns("courier"), [])
        self.assertFalse(result["submitted"])

    async def test_a_bid_without_confirmation_is_not_reported_as_submitted(self):
        result, _ = await self.run_with(Script(submit=[]))  # the model never gives a usable reply
        self.assertFalse(result["submitted"])
        self.assertIn("without a confirmation", result["notes"])

    async def test_when_time_is_short_the_clerk_is_told_to_sign_and_submit(self):
        script = Script(submit=[done(answer="R-1")])
        await self.run_with(script, seconds=submit.WRAP_UP - 30)
        self.assertIn("TIME IS SHORT", script.turns("submit")[0]["user"])

    async def test_after_the_deadline_nothing_is_entered(self):
        script = Script(submit=[done(answer="R-1")])
        result, tender = await self.run_with(script, seconds=-1)
        self.assertEqual((script.asked, tender.done, result["submitted"]), ([], [], False))

class FakeServer:
    """One HTTP server for the API and the models: answers each request with the next scripted reply per path."""

    def __init__(self, replies: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict]]]):
        self.replies, self.requests = replies, []
        fake = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

            def handle_one(self):
                length = int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)
                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)) if length else None
                # self.headers matches header names in any case: urllib sends X-api-key
                fake.requests.append({"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "headers": self.headers,
                                      "body": body})
                status, reply = fake.replies[self.path].pop(0)
                data = json.dumps(reply).encode()
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)

            do_GET = do_POST = handle_one

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()


class Case(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def serve(self, replies):
        server = FakeServer(replies)
        self.addCleanup(server.close)
        return server

class TheEntryPoint(Case):

class FakeServer:
    """One HTTP server for the API and the models: answers each request with the next scripted reply per path."""

    def __init__(self, replies: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict]]]):
        self.replies, self.requests = replies, []
        fake = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

            def handle_one(self):
                length = int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)
                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length)) if length else None
                # self.headers matches header names in any case: urllib sends X-api-key
                fake.requests.append({"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "headers": self.headers,
                                      "body": body})
                status, reply = fake.replies[self.path].pop(0)
                data = json.dumps(reply).encode()
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)

            do_GET = do_POST = handle_one

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()

        both = ["http://127.0.0.1:9222", "http://127.0.0.1:9223"]
        self.assertEqual(browsers.cdp_urls({"CDP_URLS": json.dumps(both), "CDP_URL": both[0]}), both)
        self.assertEqual(browsers.cdp_urls({"CDP_URL": both[0]}), both[:1])
        self.assertEqual(browsers.cdp_urls({"CDP_URLS": "broken", "CDP_URL": both[0]}), both[:1])
        self.assertEqual(browsers.cdp_urls({}), [])


class TheModels(Case):
    async def test_one_call_to_qwen(self):
        reply = {"id": "c1", "object": "chat.completion", "created": 0, "model": models.QWEN_MODEL, "choices": [
            {"index": 0, "finish_reason": "stop", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Weiter"}}]}
        qwen = self.serve({"/v1/chat/completions": [(200, reply)]})
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"QWEN_BASE_URL": qwen.url + "/v1", "QWEN_API_KEY": "rt_secret"}):
            self.assertEqual(await models.ask_qwen("Which button submits?"), "Weiter")
        [request] = qwen.requests
        self.assertEqual(request["body"]["model"], models.QWEN_MODEL)
        self.assertEqual(request["headers"]["Authorization"], "Bearer rt_secret")

    async def test_one_decision_from_clef(self):
        clef = self.serve({"/v1/decide": [(200, {"answers": {"q": {"type": "noul", "noul": 0.97}}})]})
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"CLEF_BASE_URL": clef.url + "/", "CLEF_API_KEY": "local"}):
            self.assertEqual(await models.ask_clef({"page": "Angebot eingegangen"}, "Is the bid in?"), 0.97)
        [request] = clef.requests
        self.assertEqual(request["body"]["questions"], {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "Is the bid in?"}})
        self.assertEqual(request["headers"]["Authorization"], "Bearer local")


class TheEntryPoint(Case):
    """main() with the agents replaced: no answer exits cleanly, an answer is submitted."""

    async def start(self, environment, answer=None):
        async def solve(task, playwright):  # the agents attach to the run's browsers themselves
            self.seen = (task, hasattr(playwright, "chromium"))
            return answer

        out = io.StringIO()
        env = {"SystemRoot": os.environ["SystemRoot"], **environment} if "SystemRoot" in os.environ else environment
        with patch.dict(os.environ, env, clear=True), patch.object(agent, "solve", solve), redirect_stdout(out):
            code = await agent.main()
        return code, out.getvalue()

    async def test_without_an_answer_it_exits_cleanly(self):
        api = self.serve({"/v1/runs/current": [(200, RUN)]})
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_API_URL": api.url, "CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN": "rt_secret"})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.seen, (RUN, True))
        self.assertIn("No answer to submit", out)
        self.assertEqual([request["method"] for request in api.requests], ["GET"])
        self.assertNotIn("REDACTED", out)

    async def test_an_answer_is_submitted_once(self):
        api = self.serve({"/v1/runs/current/answer": [(202, {"status": "accepted"})]})
        api.replies["/v1/runs/current"] = [(200, {**RUN, "submission": {
            "kind": "api", "url": api.url + "/v1/runs/current/answer"}})]
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_API_URL": api.url, "CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN": "rt_secret"}, {"bid": 1})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn("HTTP 202", out)
        self.assertEqual(api.requests[-1]["body"], {"bid": 1})

    async def test_locally_the_answer_is_printed_not_submitted(self):
        code, out = await self.start({"CHALLENGE_SCOUTING": json.dumps(RUN)}, {"bid": 1})
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertIn('{"bid": 1}', out)
        self.assertIn("local", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

item.stdout:
The winning approach is **not to overfit to the public portal**. Build a resilient, general-purpose “RFQ-to-bid” browser agent that can discover fields, extract requirements, reason over a product/price catalog, and submit a valid bid even when the UI, labels, documents, and data schema change. The challenge explicitly evaluates final performance on **unseen data**, while the public leaderboard uses the public `public-1` dataset. [ehl-challenge.atira](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/index.md)

## What the challenge is

Your agent must operate like a sales engineer across a tender portal, supplier portal, ERP, and webmail inbox: read the RFQ, collect facts, configure/price a bid, and submit it.  The leaderboard appears to rank **eligible submissions first, then quality, then cost × time**, so a correct, compliant bid matters more than merely being fast or cheap. [ehl-challenge.atira](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/index.md)

## Best architecture

Use a **planner–executor agent with strict validation**, rather than one giant prompt or hardcoded clicks.

| Layer | What it must do | Why it wins on unseen sites |
|---|---|---|
| Site understanding | Inspect DOM/accessibility tree, identify pages, forms, tables, attachments, navigation | Avoids brittle selectors and hardcoded URLs |
| Information extraction | Parse emails, PDFs, spreadsheets, drawings/spec text into structured requirements | Handles new RFQ formats and wording |
| Catalog matching | Map requirements to available products/options/rules; flag impossible requirements | Prevents invalid configurations |
| Pricing & bid logic | Compute price, lead time, compliance, and required fields | Directly affects quality and cost × time |
| Submission validator | Check every mandatory field, units, file uploads, confirmation screens | Avoids zero-score “eligible=false” runs |
| Recovery system | Retry, backtrack, use alternate selectors, ask itself what changed | Survives unexpected UI states |

## Practical winning strategy

1. **Make eligibility your first objective.** A beautifully priced bid earns nothing if the agent fails to submit or misses a mandatory field. Build a pre-submission checklist: every required input filled, files attached, currency/units correct, terms accepted, confirmation captured.

2. **Use semantic element discovery, not fixed XPath.** Let the agent read the accessibility tree/DOM and match by meaning: “deadline,” “quantity,” “delivery date,” “unit price,” “upload,” “submit.” Then verify with multiple signals—label, placeholder, nearby text, input type, and table headers.

3. **Build a universal RFQ schema.** Internally convert every RFQ into fields such as:
   - customer, RFQ ID, deadline
   - line items, quantities, units
   - technical specifications and tolerances
   - delivery location/date
   - compliance/certification requirements
   - commercial terms
   - requested documents

   Then map that schema to whatever portal appears. This is the core generalization mechanism.

4. **Separate “reading” from “deciding.”** Use one pipeline to extract evidence and another to make bid decisions. Every price, configuration, and exclusion should cite a source: an email, PDF page, catalog row, ERP field, or portal field. This reduces hallucinated bids.

5. **Handle documents aggressively.** The real difficulty will likely be messy PDFs, scanned specs, email threads, and inconsistent product data. Add OCR where needed, extract tables, preserve page/section references, and normalize units and date formats.

6. **Create a self-check loop before submitting.** Before final submission, run checks like:
   - Does every RFQ line have a response or explicit exception?
   - Are quantities, units, and part numbers consistent?
   - Is the total price reproducible from line items?
   - Are mandatory attachments present?
   - Does the final portal summary match the intended bid?

7. **Optimize time only after correctness.** Since scoring includes cost × time, cache repeated lookups, avoid unnecessary page revisits, parallelize independent document parsing, and use a cheaper model for extraction but a stronger model for ambiguous configuration/pricing decisions.

## What to avoid

- Hardcoding the public website’s buttons, URLs, table positions, or product IDs.
- Treating the public dataset as the test set; it is only for scouting and testing. [ehl-challenge.atira](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/start)
- Letting the LLM freely invent catalog items, prices, or compliance answers.
- Submitting without a machine-readable validation report.
- Spending the hackathon making the public leaderboard score marginally better while sacrificing robustness.

## Hackathon execution plan

- **Hours 0–3:** Understand scoring, inspect sample RFQs, map the full workflow, define the universal RFQ/bid schema.
- **Hours 3–10:** Build browser-navigation and form-filling engine with semantic selectors and recovery.
- **Hours 10–18:** Build document/RFQ extraction and catalog matching.
- **Hours 18–26:** Build pricing, validation, and submission pipeline.
- **Hours 26–34:** Create 20–50 synthetic “unseen site” variations: renamed labels, reordered forms, extra steps, different file types, missing optional data.
- **Final hours:** Run end-to-end tests, prioritize eligibility, log every failure, and submit early with a safe fallback.

## One-line principle

**Build an agent that understands the task, not one that memorizes the website.** If your system can take a completely new portal, extract the RFQ requirements reliably, produce a defensible priced bid, validate every submission field, and recover from UI surprises, you will have the best chance on the hidden evaluation set. [ehl-challenge.atira](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/index.md)

3. **Build a universal RFQ schema.** Internally convert every RFQ into fields such as:
   - customer, RFQ ID, deadline
   - line items, quantities, units
   - technical specifications and tolerances
   - delivery location/date

   - commercial terms
   - requested documents

   Then map that schema to whatever portal appears. This is the core generalization mechanism.

4. **Separate “reading” from “deciding.”** Use one pipeline to extract evidence and another to make bid decisions. Every price, configuration, and exclusion should cite a source: an email, PDF page, catalog row, ERP field, or portal field. This reduces hallucinated bids.

5. **Handle documents aggressively.** The real difficulty will likely be messy PDFs, scanned specs, email threads, and inconsistent product data. Add OCR where needed, extract tables, preserve page/section references, and normalize units and date formats.

   - Are mandatory attachments present?

"""The last check before the bid is entered: plain code, no model call.

Every field of the answer scores on its own, but a few mistakes cost more than their own field: an extra or duplicate
position costs a whole position's share, a total that is not the sum of the lines loses the total and the arithmetic
points, and a malformed answer is rejected while the clock keeps running. `check` repairs what can be repaired
without guessing (duplicates, positions the tender does not have, a total that does not add up, impossible values)
and reports every change, so the run log shows what would otherwise have been lost.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from calculator import Bid, Line

CENT = Decimal("0.01")


def _cents(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(value).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def check(bid: Bid, tender_positions: set[str] | None = None) -> tuple[Bid, list[str]]:
    """The bid, repaired where that needs no guess, and a list of what was wrong."""
    issues: list[str] = []
    if bid.decision not in ("bid", "no_bid"):
        issues.append(f'decision "{bid.decision}" is neither bid nor no_bid; using bid')
        bid.decision = "bid"
    if not (Decimal(0) <= bid.discount_percent <= Decimal(100)):
        issues.append(f"discount {bid.discount_percent} % is out of range; using 0")
        bid.discount_percent = Decimal(0)

    if bid.decision == "no_bid":
        if bid.lines or bid.total_net != 0:
            issues.append("a no_bid carries no positions and a total of 0; cleared them")
            bid.lines, bid.total_net = [], Decimal(0)
        return bid, issues

    kept: list[Line] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    known = {p.strip() for p in tender_positions} if tender_positions else None
    for line in bid.lines:
        key = line.position.strip()
        if key in seen:
            issues.append(f"position {key} appears twice; kept the first (a duplicate costs a position's share)")
            continue
        if known is not None and key not in known:
            issues.append(f"position {key} is not in the tender; dropped it (an extra position costs a share)")
            continue
        problem = _line_problem(line)
        if problem:
            issues.append(f"position {key}: {problem}; omitted it rather than enter a broken line")
            bid.omitted.append(key)
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        kept.append(line)
    bid.lines = kept

    total = _cents(sum((Decimal(line.quantity) * line.unit_price for line in kept), Decimal(0)))
    if _cents(bid.total_net) != total:
        issues.append(f"total {bid.total_net} is not the sum of the lines ({total}); using the sum")
        bid.total_net = total
    return bid, issues


def _line_problem(line: Line) -> str | None:
    if not line.material_number or not str(line.material_number).strip():
        return "no material number"
    if not isinstance(line.quantity, int) or line.quantity <= 0:
        return f"quantity {line.quantity!r} is not a whole number of pieces above 0"
    if line.unit_price is None or line.unit_price < 0:
        return f"unit price {line.unit_price!r} is missing or negative"
    if line.lead_time_weeks is None or line.lead_time_weeks < 0:
        return f"lead time {line.lead_time_weeks!r} is missing or negative"
    for name in ("base_unit_price", "surcharge_per_unit", "packaging_per_unit", "rebate_total"):
        value = getattr(line, name)
        if value is not None and value < 0:
            setattr(line, name, None)  # optional: a blank costs only its own points, a wrong sign may be refused
    return None

content.text:
I agree with the note’s main thesis: it is the right strategy for this challenge. “Understand the task, not the portal” is exactly the fair-play and hidden-evaluation requirement.

The current project already aligns well:

- Model-directed browser navigation rather than fixed URLs/selectors.
- Separate evidence gathering, typed extraction, deterministic pricing, and bid submission.
- Exact commercial arithmetic and a no-model pre-submit bid validator.
- Generic handling for dialogs, frames, downloads, pagination, retries, and unexpected page states.
- The latest browser fixes materially strengthen the “unseen UI” goal.

Where the note is especially useful is in showing our remaining gap: we validate the calculated `Bid`, but not yet a deterministic, portal-side submission checklist. `submit.py` instructs the model to verify the review page and receipt, but a stronger final gate should explicitly inspect the live form for:

- required/error fields;
- all intended tender positions;
- correct total and discount;
- signature/TAN status;
- a captured success receipt.

I would prioritize that over building a giant generic “universal RFQ schema.” The existing typed case file is already tailored to the challenge’s fixed bid rules and answer schema; making it industry-generic would add scope and model cost without necessarily improving the private-dataset score.

One caution: the note’s “use a stronger model for ambiguous decisions” is only safe if it stays within Atira’s allowed, metered model path. The current default Qwen setup is the safe baseline; OpenAI extraction should remain explicitly opt-in and proxy-metered.

The other meaningful gap is documents: [browser_env.py](D:/Personal_Projects/TUM_HackathonFinal/starter-kit/browser_env.py) reads HTML, downloads, archives, and PDFs, but it does not provide OCR for scanned/image-only specifications. I would add that only after confirming the challenge actually serves such documents.

My priority order would be:

1. Add a live-form pre-submit checklist/report.
2. Test recovery on synthetic portal variants: renamed fields, reordered steps, validation errors, delayed TAN, interrupted session.
3. Preserve source/provenance alongside extracted facts, so the agent can resolve contradictions defensibly.
4. Add OCR only if observed inputs require it.

So: excellent strategic memo; it validates the architecture we chose, but it also points directly to the highest-value next improvement—submission eligibility validation.

Inspect the graph:

  neighbors        Who calls this / what does it call (targeted relations)
  impact           One-shot blast radius for changing a symbol
  def              What a name IS: declaration, fields, and method surface
  explain          Resolve symbols named by a failing build or test
  symbols          Stream every symbol definition (bulk NDJSON)
  edges            Stream every relation (bulk NDJSON)
  snapshot         Stream the whole graph: files, symbols, and relations (bulk NDJSON)
  snapshot-query   Query a compact snapshot without rebuilding the graph

Analyze changes & more:

  stats            Human report: graph usage vs grep/read, and estimated token savings

Help & diagnostics:

For coding agents: run "entire graph agent-guide" or "entire graph init-agents".
"""The last stage: an agent enters the calculated bid in the tender portal, signs it and reads the receipt.

The calculator has fixed every number. `submit_bid` hands them to a model as a bid sheet and lets it drive whatever
bid form the portal has: where the form is, what each step wants, which notation a field takes, how a position is
left out and when the signing code has to be requested are all read from the pages. A second agent, on the webmail,
fetches that code when the first one asks for it. Nothing here knows a field name or the order of the steps.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from decimal import Decimal

from browser_env import Tab
from calculator import Bid
from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

WRAP_UP = 150  # seconds before the deadline at which entering stops and signing starts: the code takes a while
MAIL_BUDGET = 120  # seconds one request to the mailbox may take
CLERK_STEPS, COURIER_STEPS = 120, 25
# Entering a bid is reading a form and copying values: without the model's long reasoning a turn takes about half
# the time, and the reply's "thought" still leaves it room to check a conversion.
CLERK_THINKS, COURIER_THINKS = False, False

CLERK = """You are the bid clerk of a manufacturer's sales engineering team. Your colleagues have researched a
public tender and a calculator has priced it: the BID SHEET below is the final result. You work the tender portal
"{site}" at {url} in your own browser tab, and your whole job is to get exactly this bid into the portal's bid
form, sign it, submit it and read the confirmation. You do not research and you do not recalculate.

TASK BRIEF (background on what a valid submission is; the values to enter come from the bid sheet)
{brief}
END OF BRIEF

BIDDER
{bidder}

BID SHEET
{sheet}

Reading the bid sheet
- "decision" is "bid" or "no_bid". A no_bid has no positions and a total of zero: take the form's way of
  declining, and still sign and submit it.
- "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.
- "material" describes the offered product, for forms that make you pick or configure it: choose what equals
  these values.
- Amounts are net EUR, written here with a decimal point and without thousands separators. A field may expect
  another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.
- null means the value is not known: leave that field empty. 0 or 0.00 is a known zero: enter it.
- "omitted_positions" could not be priced. Never invent values for them: use the form's explicit way of leaving
  a position out, if it has one.

{actions}
One more action:
  {{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "<what you need and how to recognise it>"}}
      A colleague who has the bidder's mailbox open in another browser looks for it and answers. This is how you
      get the signing code (TAN) the portal sends by mail. Ask only after you have triggered the code in the
      portal, and pass on what you know about it (the tender reference, that you requested it just now, anything
      the portal displayed about it): the mailbox also holds older codes that no longer work.

How to work
- Start from the page you are on and find the bid form of tender {reference}. Log in again if the portal asks.
- A bid form asks, in an order of its own, for things like the bidder's details, bid or no bid, the positions,
  the commercial terms, declarations, a review and a signature. Read each page and give it what it asks for,
  from the bidder data and the bid sheet. Fill every field the sheet has a value for, optional ones included.
- Read the form's own instructions: when entries are saved, what going back does, which fields are required.
  Do the fields of a page in one reply, then the control that saves them or moves on.
- After each step look at the result. If the form reports an error or did not keep a value, correct that field
  before you move on.
- Declarations: read what each one says. Give the confirmations a valid bid needs; leave unticked, or untick,
  options that would alter the bid or have nothing to do with it.
- On the review page compare what the form lists with the bid sheet: reference, decision, every position, the
  discount and the total. Go back and correct differences while there is time.
- Signing: trigger the code in the portal, get it with ask_mail, enter it and submit. A submission is final.
  If the portal rejects a code, request a fresh one instead of trying the same again.
- You are finished only when the portal confirms that the bid was received. Then finish with done and put the
  confirmation (its receipt number or code, else its wording) in "answer". If you cannot submit, finish with
  done without "answer" and say why in "summary".
- Watch the time. A bid that is entered but not submitted scores nothing; a submitted bid with positions left
  out keeps the points of the positions it holds. When the head of a turn says time is short, do as it says.
"""

COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.

{actions}

How to work
- The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
- Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
  unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message that matches the request. Open
  the message itself and check its reference and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
- Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
  message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
- Log in again if the webmail asks.
- Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
  If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
"""


def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
    return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"


def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
    positions = []
    for line in bid.lines:
        material = line.material
        positions.append({
            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
            "material": None if material is None else {
                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
            "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}


async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
                     deadline: float) -> dict:
    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).

    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
    """
    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
    codes: list[str] = []  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again

    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
        if not task:
            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
        if mail_tab is None:
            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"

        def request() -> str:
            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
            if codes:
                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
            return text

        system = COURIER.format(site=mail_tab.site_id, url=mail_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
        courier = Agent("courier", mail_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
        outcome = await courier.run()
        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
        if not answer:
            return "the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
        codes.append(answer)
        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")

    def heading() -> str:
        left = int(deadline - time.time())
        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
        if codes:
            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
        if left < WRAP_UP:
            text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
                     "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
        return text

    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
                          sheet=json.dumps(bid_sheet(bid), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
    clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading, extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS)
    outcome = await clerk.run()
    receipt = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
    notes = str(outcome.get("summary") or "")
    if not outcome.get("done"):
        notes = (notes + " " if notes else "") + f"stopped after {outcome.get('steps', 0)} steps without a confirmation"
    return {"submitted": bool(outcome.get("done") and receipt), "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes}
"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
from browser_env import Tab

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
            self.steps += 1
            clock = time.time()
            try:
                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
            read_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
            model_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            actions = reply.get("actions")
            if isinstance(actions, dict):
                actions = [actions]
            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
                failures += 1
                if failures >= 4:
                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
                    break
                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
                continue
            failures = 0
            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
            head = page.split("\n", 2)
            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})
            if os.environ.get("AGENT_TRACE"):  # what the agent saw and answered, one file per turn
                os.makedirs(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], exist_ok=True)
                with open(os.path.join(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], f"{self.name}_{self.steps:03d}.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                    handle.write(user + "\n\n===== REPLY =====\n" + json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

            signature = json.dumps(actions, sort_keys=True) + self.tab.page.url
            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else 0
            last_signature = signature

            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
            for action in actions[:8]:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                do = action.get("do")
                if do == "done":
                    finished = action
                    break
                if do == "wait":
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    results.append("waited two seconds")
                    continue
                if do in self.extra:
                    try:
                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
                    continue
                if moved:
                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
                    continue
                before = self.tab.page.url
                try:
                    result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result = f"{do} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s and was stopped; the page may be stuck"
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
                results.append(result)
                if do in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    self.held = (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
                elif do in NAVIGATING:
                    self.held = None
                if do in NAVIGATING or self.tab.page.url != before or not await self._alive():
                    moved = True
            self.log(f"(read {read_s:.1f}s, model {model_s:.1f}s, act {time.time() - clock:.1f}s) {thought} | "
                     f"{json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))
            if repeats >= 2:
                results.append("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result: they do not work "
                               "here. Read the page again from the top for another way (a further check, a toggle, a "
                               "different link, a search), or finish with done.")
            if finished is not None:
                outcome.update(summary=str(finished.get("summary", "")), answer=finished.get("answer"))
                news = await self.idle("done") if self.idle else None
                if news is None:
                    outcome["done"] = True
                    break
                results.append(news)
        outcome["steps"] = self.steps
        return outcome
"""The shared case file: what the site agents have filed, as structured facts.

An agent files a page it judged relevant (`keep`); a model call turns that page into records of one of the kinds
below; this module merges them, works out from the brief's rules what is still unknown (the open questions every

def _int(value) -> int | None:
    number = parse_number(value)
    return int(number) if number is not None else None


def _text(value) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    return text if text and text.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a", "-", "—") else None


def _merge(store: dict, key, record: dict) -> None:
    old = store.setdefault(key, {})
    for name, value in record.items():
        if value is not None and value != "" and value != []:
            old[name] = value

    def __init__(self, brief: str, context: dict):

        self.messages: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        self.answers: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}  # question id -> (complete | absent, note)
        self.filed: set[str] = set()
        self.news: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self.pending = 0
        self.version = 0
        self._changed = asyncio.Event()

    # ---- filing evidence -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _bump(self) -> None:
        self.version += 1
        self._changed.set()

    async def wait_change(self, seen: int, timeout: float) -> bool:
        """True once the case file has moved past version `seen`."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        end = loop.time() + timeout
        while self.version == seen:
            self._changed.clear()
            left = end - loop.time()
            if left <= 0:
                return False
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._changed.wait(), timeout=left)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                return False
        return True

    def take_news(self, agent: str) -> list[str]:
        return self.news.pop(agent, [])

    def file(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str) -> str:
        """File a document an agent chose; the extraction runs in the background and reports back as news."""
        if kind not in SHAPES:
            return f'unknown kind "{kind}"; the kinds are: {", ".join(SHAPES)}'
        if len(text.strip()) < 20:
            return "there is no document to file"
        # The pages of a collected list are read side by side: shorter replies, sooner.
        pages = [page for page in re.split(re.escape(PAGE_BREAK) + r" \d+ =====\n", text) if len(page.strip()) >= 20]
        folder = os.environ.get("AGENT_DOCS_DIR")
        if folder:
            os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
        fresh = 0
        for page in pages:
            digest = hashlib.sha1((kind + "\n" + page).encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
            if digest in self.filed:
                continue
            self.filed.add(digest)
            self.pending += 1
            fresh += 1
            if folder:  # local tuning only: preserve the exact evidence that was filed, one page per file
                filename = f"{len(self.filed):03d}-{kind}-{digest[:8]}.json"
                with open(os.path.join(folder, filename), "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
                    json.dump({"kind": kind, "source": source, "agent": agent, "text": page}, out,
                              ensure_ascii=False)
            asyncio.ensure_future(self._extract(kind, page, source, agent, digest))
        if not fresh:
            return f"this document is already filed as {kind}"
        return (f"filed {len(text)} characters ({fresh} page(s)) from {source} as {kind}; the facts in it will be "
                "reported to you")

    async def _extract(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str, digest: str = "") -> None:
        try:
            prompt = (f"TASK BRIEF\n{self.brief}\n\nThe tender reference is {self.reference}; the scenario date is "
                      f"{self.scenario.isoformat()}.\n\nKIND OF RECORD: {kind}\nSHAPE\n{SHAPES[kind]}\n\n"
                      f"EVIDENCE (from {source})\n{text[:60000]}")

class _Text(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.parts, self.skip = [], 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("script", "style"):
            self.skip += 1
        elif tag in ("p", "div", "tr", "br", "li", "h1", "h2", "h3", "table"):
            self.parts.append("\n")
        elif tag in ("td", "th"):
            self.parts.append(" | ")

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("script", "style") and self.skip:
            self.skip -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.skip:
            self.parts.append(data)


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[​-‏⁠-⁤﻿­͏؜᠎]", "", text)
    return re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", re.sub(r"[  ]+", " ", text)).strip()


def without_ids(text: str) -> str:
    """A document for reading only: the element ids of the pages it came from are gone by now."""
    return re.sub(r"\[\d+\] (?=(?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?[a-z-]+(?:\([a-z]+\))? \")", "", text)


def document_text(data: bytes, content_type: str, name: str, depth: int = 0) -> str:
    """The text of a fetched file: archives are opened, markup is stripped, PDFs are read when pypdf is installed."""
    kind = (content_type or "").lower()
    lower = name.lower()
    if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" or "zip" in kind or lower.endswith(".zip"):
        try:
            archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            return "(unreadable archive)"
        parts = [f"ARCHIVE {name} with files: " + ", ".join(info.filename for info in archive.infolist())]
        for info in archive.infolist()[:40]:
            if info.is_dir() or depth > 2:
                continue
            parts.append(f"=== FILE {info.filename} ===\n" + document_text(archive.read(info), "", info.filename, depth + 1))
        return "\n".join(parts)
    if data[:5] == b"%PDF-" or "pdf" in kind:
        try:
            from pypdf import PdfReader
            return clean_text("\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data)).pages))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"(PDF could not be read: {error})"
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if "html" in kind or "xml" in kind or re.search(r"<(html|body|table|div|p|w:document|worksheet)\b", text[:4000], re.I):
        parser = _Text()
        parser.feed(text)
        text = "".join(parser.parts)
    return clean_text(text)

class Script:
    """Stands in for llm.chat_json: answers each agent, named by `label`, with its next scripted reply."""

    def __init__(self, **replies):
        self.replies, self.asked = replies, []

    async def __call__(self, messages, *, think=True, max_tokens=6000, label=""):
        self.asked.append({"label": label, "think": think, "system": messages[0]["content"],
                           "user": messages[-1]["content"]})
        return self.replies[label].pop(0) if self.replies.get(label) else {}

    def turns(self, label: str) -> list[dict]:
        return [call for call in self.asked if call["label"] == label]


def done(**fields) -> dict:
    return {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "done", **fields}]}
