"""The browser layer against local pages: what a model is shown of each trick a business website plays on its
visitors, and whether the tab's actions do what they report. A throwaway server on 127.0.0.1 serves tests/fixtures
(one small hand-written page per trick); a local headless Chromium is driven through browser_env.Tab alone."""
import asyncio
import functools
import html
import inspect
import io
import json
import os
import re
import secrets
import sys
import threading
import time
import unicodedata
import unittest
import zipfile
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from string import Template
from typing import NamedTuple
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright  # noqa: E402

from browser_env import Tab  # noqa: E402

FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures"
LOGIN = {"username": "pat.example", "password": "REDACTED"}  # invented: only the fixture site knows them
TYPES = {".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8", ".csv": "text/csv; charset=utf-8", ".txt": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"}


class FixtureSite:
    """tests/fixtures over HTTP, plus the few things a static file cannot do: a login that sets a session cookie, a
    list paged by query string, rows that arrive on request, answers that take a moment, a form echo, downloads."""

    ORDERS = [(11, "Widget A", 4), (12, "Widget B", 2), (13, "Gasket", 30), (14, "Widget A", 1), (15, "Bolt", 500),
              (16, "Widget B", 8), (17, "Widget A", 4)]
    PER_PAGE = 3
    LATER_MESSAGES = {22: ["Message 23: Invoice sent", "Message 24: Gasket restocked"],
                      24: ["Message 25: Order 17 closed"]}
    DELAY = 0.3  # seconds a "slow" answer takes: a local server answers faster than any real network

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests: list[tuple[str, str, dict]] = []  # (method, path with query, form fields), in order
        self.sessions: dict[str, str] = {}  # session cookie -> user name
        self.ticket = secrets.token_hex(4)
        site = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

            def do_GET(self):
                site.answer(self, {})

            def do_POST(self):
                body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)).decode()
                site.answer(self, {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True).items()})

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}"
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()

    @property
    def paths(self) -> list[str]:
        return [path for _, path, _ in self.requests]

    def posted(self, path: str) -> dict | None:
        """The fields of the last form posted to `path`."""
        return next((form for method, at, form in reversed(self.requests) if method == "POST" and at == path), None)

    def answer(self, request, form: dict) -> None:
        if request.path == "/favicon.ico":  # the browser's own idea, not a step of the tab
            return self.send(request, 404, "", TYPES[".txt"])
        self.requests.append((request.command, request.path, form))
        url = urlsplit(request.path)
        query = {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query, keep_blank_values=True).items()}
        cookie = re.search(r"session=(\w+)", request.headers.get("cookie") or "")
        user = self.sessions.get(cookie[1]) if cookie else None
        path = url.path
        if path.startswith("/slow/"):
            time.sleep(self.DELAY)
            path = path[len("/slow"):]
        if path.startswith("/private/"):
            if not user:
                return self.send(request, 403, "Sign in first.", TYPES[".txt"])
            path = path[len("/private"):]

        if path == "/login" and request.command == "POST":
            if form == {"ticket": self.ticket, **LOGIN}:
                session = secrets.token_hex(8)
                self.sessions[session] = form["username"]
                return self.send(request, 303, "", TYPES[".txt"],
                                 {"location": "/account", "set-cookie": f"session={session}; Path=/; HttpOnly"})
            return self.send(request, 200, self.page("login.html", ticket=self.ticket,
                                                     message='<p role="alert">Sign-in failed.</p>'))
        if path == "/login":
            return self.send(request, 200, self.page("login.html", ticket=self.ticket, message=""))
        if path == "/account":
            if not user:
                return self.send(request, 302, "", TYPES[".txt"], {"location": "/login"})
            return self.send(request, 200, self.page("account.html", username=html.escape(user)))
        if path == "/orders":
            return self.send(request, 200, self.orders(int(query.get("page") or 1)))
        if path == "/more-messages":
            time.sleep(self.DELAY)
            after = int(query["after"])
            rows = self.LATER_MESSAGES[after]
            following = after + len(rows)
            body = {"rows": rows, "next": f"/more-messages?after={following}" if following in self.LATER_MESSAGES else None}
            return self.send(request, 200, json.dumps(body), "application/json")
        if path == "/echo":
            fields = "".join(f"<dt>{html.escape(key)}</dt><dd>{html.escape(value)}</dd>"
                             for key, value in (form or query).items())
            return self.send(request, 200, f"<!doctype html><title>Received</title><h1>Received</h1><dl>{fields}</dl>")
        if path.startswith("/arrived/"):
            name = html.escape(path[len("/arrived/"):])
            return self.send(request, 200, f"<!doctype html><title>{name}</title><h1>You arrived at {name}</h1>")
        if path == "/bundle.zip":
            data = io.BytesIO()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(data, "w") as archive:
                archive.writestr("readme.txt", "Bundle for order 17\n")
                archive.writestr("items.csv", "item;quantity\nWidget A;4\n")
            return self.send(request, 200, data.getvalue(), "application/zip",
                             {"content-disposition": 'attachment; filename="order-17-documents.zip"'})
        file = (FIXTURES / path.lstrip("/")).resolve()
        if FIXTURES in file.parents and file.is_file():
            return self.send(request, 200, file.read_bytes(), TYPES.get(file.suffix, "application/octet-stream"))
        return self.send(request, 404, "Not found.", TYPES[".txt"])

    def page(self, name: str, **values) -> str:
        return Template((FIXTURES / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")).substitute(values)

    def orders(self, number: int) -> str:
        pages = -(-len(self.ORDERS) // self.PER_PAGE)
        shown = self.ORDERS[(number - 1) * self.PER_PAGE:number * self.PER_PAGE]
        rows = "\n".join(f"  <tr><td>Order {order}</td><td>{item}</td><td>{quantity}</td></tr>"
                         for order, item, quantity in shown)
        previous = f'<a href="/orders?page={number - 1}">Previous page</a>' if number > 1 else ""
        following = f'<a href="/orders?page={number + 1}">Next page</a>' if number < pages else ""
        return self.page("paged_list.html", page=number, pages=pages, rows=rows, previous=previous, next=following)

    @staticmethod
    def send(request, status: int, body, content_type: str = TYPES[".html"], headers: dict | None = None) -> None:
        data = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body
        request.send_response(status)
        request.send_header("content-type", content_type)
        request.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        request.send_header("cache-control", "no-store")
        for name, value in (headers or {}).items():
            request.send_header(name, value)
        try:
            request.end_headers()
            request.wfile.write(data)
        except ConnectionError:  # the browser closed the tab before the answer was out
            pass


SITE: FixtureSite = None
LOOP: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop = None
PLAYWRIGHT = BROWSER = None
READ: dict[str, str] = {}  # fixture path -> its first observation, for tests that only read


def setUpModule():
    """One server, one event loop and one Chromium for the whole module: a browser per test would take longer than
    the tests. The Playwright driver starts here with the real environment (on Windows it needs SystemRoot, which
    test_kit's entry-point tests clear for the length of a test)."""
    global SITE, LOOP, PLAYWRIGHT, BROWSER
    SITE = FixtureSite()
    LOOP = asyncio.new_event_loop()
    PLAYWRIGHT = LOOP.run_until_complete(async_playwright().start())
    BROWSER = LOOP.run_until_complete(PLAYWRIGHT.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS", "1") != "0"))


def tearDownModule():
    LOOP.run_until_complete(BROWSER.close())
    LOOP.run_until_complete(PLAYWRIGHT.stop())
    LOOP.close()
    SITE.close()
    READ.clear()


def on_the_loop(test):
    @functools.wraps(test)
    def run(self):
        LOOP.run_until_complete(asyncio.wait_for(test(self), 40))  # a hung action fails its test, not the suite
    return run


class Control(NamedTuple):
    """One numbered control of an observation; `text` is everything the observation says about it."""
    id: int
    kind: str
    name: str
    text: str


CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\](?: \(in collapsed menu\))? ([a-z-]+)(?:\([a-z-]+\))? "([^"]*)"')


def controls(observation: str) -> list[Control]:
    found = []
    for line in observation.splitlines():
        marks = list(CONTROL.finditer(line))
        for mark, following in zip(marks, marks[1:] + [None]):
            found.append(Control(int(mark[1]), mark[2], mark[3], line[mark.start():following.start() if following else None]))
    return found


class Case(unittest.TestCase):
    """A test is a coroutine on the module's loop. `open` gives it a tab of its own, with fresh cookies, on a
    fixture; `read` the observation of a fixture nobody acts on."""
    maxDiff = None

    def __init_subclass__(cls, **kwargs):
        super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs)
        for name, test in list(vars(cls).items()):
            if name.startswith("test") and inspect.iscoroutinefunction(test):
                setattr(cls, name, on_the_loop(test))

    async def open(self, path: str, credentials: dict | None = None) -> Tab:
        context = await BROWSER.new_context()
        self.addCleanup(lambda: LOOP.run_until_complete(context.close()))
        tab = Tab(await context.new_page(), {"siteId": "fixture", "url": SITE.url + "/", "credentials": credentials})
        SITE.requests.clear()
        await tab.goto(path)
        return tab

    async def read(self, path: str) -> str:
        if path not in READ:
            READ[path] = await (await self.open(path)).observe()

"""The last stage: an agent enters the calculated bid in the tender portal, signs it and reads the receipt.

The calculator has fixed every number. `submit_bid` hands them to a model as a bid sheet and lets it drive whatever
bid form the portal has: where the form is, what each step wants, which notation a field takes, how a position is
left out and when the signing code has to be requested are all read from the pages. A second agent, on the webmail,
fetches that code when the first one asks for it. Nothing here knows a field name or the order of the steps.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from decimal import Decimal

from browser_env import Tab
from calculator import Bid
from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

WRAP_UP = 150  # seconds before the deadline at which entering stops and signing starts: the code takes a while
MAIL_BUDGET = 120  # seconds one request to the mailbox may take
CLERK_STEPS, COURIER_STEPS = 120, 25
# Entering a bid is reading a form and copying values: without the model's long reasoning a turn takes about half
# the time, and the reply's "thought" still leaves it room to check a conversion.
CLERK_THINKS, COURIER_THINKS = False, False

CLERK = """You are the bid clerk of a manufacturer's sales engineering team. Your colleagues have researched a
public tender and a calculator has priced it: the BID SHEET below is the final result. You work the tender portal
"{site}" at {url} in your own browser tab, and your whole job is to get exactly this bid into the portal's bid
form, sign it, submit it and read the confirmation. You do not research and you do not recalculate.

TASK BRIEF (background on what a valid submission is; the values to enter come from the bid sheet)
{brief}
END OF BRIEF

BIDDER
{bidder}

BID SHEET
{sheet}

Reading the bid sheet
- "decision" is "bid" or "no_bid". A no_bid has no positions and a total of zero: take the form's way of
  declining, and still sign and submit it.
- "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.
- "material" describes the offered product, for forms that make you pick or configure it: choose what equals
  these values.
- Amounts are net EUR, written here with a decimal point and without thousands separators. A field may expect
  another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.
- null means the value is not known: leave that field empty. 0 or 0.00 is a known zero: enter it.
- "omitted_positions" could not be priced. Never invent values for them: use the form's explicit way of leaving
  a position out, if it has one.

{actions}
One more action:
  {{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "<what you need and how to recognise it>"}}
      A colleague who has the bidder's mailbox open in another browser looks for it and answers. This is how you
      get the signing code (TAN) the portal sends by mail. Ask only after you have triggered the code in the
      portal, and pass on what you know about it (the tender reference, that you requested it just now, anything
      the portal displayed about it): the mailbox also holds older codes that no longer work.

How to work
- Start from the page you are on and find the bid form of tender {reference}. Log in again if the portal asks.
- A bid form asks, in an order of its own, for things like the bidder's details, bid or no bid, the positions,
  the commercial terms, declarations, a review and a signature. Read each page and give it what it asks for,
  from the bidder data and the bid sheet. Fill every field the sheet has a value for, optional ones included.
- Read the form's own instructions: when entries are saved, what going back does, which fields are required.
  Do the fields of a page in one reply, then the control that saves them or moves on.
- After each step look at the result. If the form reports an error or did not keep a value, correct that field
  before you move on.
- Declarations: read what each one says. Give the confirmations a valid bid needs; leave unticked, or untick,
  options that would alter the bid or have nothing to do with it.
- On the review page compare what the form lists with the bid sheet: reference, decision, every position, the
  discount and the total. Go back and correct differences while there is time.
- Signing: trigger the code in the portal, get it with ask_mail, enter it and submit. A submission is final.
  If the portal rejects a code, request a fresh one instead of trying the same again.
- You are finished only when the portal confirms that the bid was received. Then finish with done and put the
  confirmation (its receipt number or code, else its wording) in "answer". If you cannot submit, finish with
  done without "answer" and say why in "summary".
- Watch the time. A bid that is entered but not submitted scores nothing; a submitted bid with positions left
  out keeps the points of the positions it holds. When the head of a turn says time is short, do as it says.
"""

COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.

{actions}

How to work
- The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
- Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
  unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message that matches the request. Open
  the message itself and check its reference and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
- Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
  message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
- Log in again if the webmail asks.
- Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
  If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
"""


def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
    return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"


def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
    positions = []
    for line in bid.lines:
        material = line.material
        positions.append({
            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
            "material": None if material is None else {
                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
            "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}


async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
                     deadline: float) -> dict:
    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).

    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
    """
    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
    codes: list[str] = []  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again

    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
        if not task:
            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
        if mail_tab is None:
            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"

        def request() -> str:
            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
            if codes:
                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
            return text

        system = COURIER.format(site=mail_tab.site_id, url=mail_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
        courier = Agent("courier", mail_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
        outcome = await courier.run()
        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
        if not answer:
            return "the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
        codes.append(answer)
        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")

    def heading() -> str:
        left = int(deadline - time.time())
        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
        if codes:
            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
        if left < WRAP_UP:
            text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
                     "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
        return text

    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
                          sheet=json.dumps(bid_sheet(bid), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
    clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading, extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS)
    outcome = await clerk.run()
    receipt = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
    notes = str(outcome.get("summary") or "")
    if not outcome.get("done"):
        notes = (notes + " " if notes else "") + f"stopped after {outcome.get('steps', 0)} steps without a confirmation"
    return {"submitted": bool(outcome.get("done") and receipt), "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes}
"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.

One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import time
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import llm
from browser_env import Tab

ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].

Browser actions:
  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one

Reading the page:
- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
  lead and what their attributes say.
- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
"""

STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
FULL_TURNS = 2  # how many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text
NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch"}


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None):
        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
        let it stop (returns None)."""
        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
        self.extra = extra or {}
        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
        self.turns: list[dict] = []
        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
        self.steps = 0
        self.started = time.time()

    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)

    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
        return messages

    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
        if do == "login":
            return await tab.login()
        if do == "click":
            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
        if do == "fill":
            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
        if do == "select":
            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
        if do == "set":
            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
        if do == "goto":
            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
        if do == "back":
            return await tab.back()
        if do == "reload":
            return await tab.reload()
        if do == "collect":
            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
        if do == "fetch":
            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
        return f'unknown action "{do}"'

    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False

    async def run(self) -> dict:
        results: list[str] = []
        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
            try:
                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
            self.steps += 1
            clock = time.time()
            try:
                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
            read_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
            model_s = time.time() - clock
            clock = time.time()
            actions = reply.get("actions")
            if isinstance(actions, dict):
                actions = [actions]
            if not isinstance(actions, list) or not actions:
                failures += 1
                if failures >= 4:
                    self.log("the model gave no usable actions four times; stopping")
                    break
                results = ['your reply had no "actions" list; reply with {"thought": ..., "actions": [...]}']
                continue
            failures = 0
            thought = str(reply.get("thought", ""))[:300]
            head = page.split("\n", 2)
            short = f"RESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text[:700]}\n\nPAGE (text dropped)\n" + "\n".join(head[:2])
            self.turns.append({"user": user, "short": short, "assistant": json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False)})
            if os.environ.get("AGENT_TRACE"):  # what the agent saw and answered, one file per turn
                os.makedirs(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], exist_ok=True)
                with open(os.path.join(os.environ["AGENT_TRACE"], f"{self.name}_{self.steps:03d}.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                    handle.write(user + "\n\n===== REPLY =====\n" + json.dumps(reply, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

            signature = json.dumps(actions, sort_keys=True) + self.tab.page.url
            repeats = repeats + 1 if signature == last_signature else 0
            last_signature = signature

            results, finished, moved = [], None, False
            for action in actions[:8]:
                if not isinstance(action, dict):
                    continue
                do = action.get("do")
                if do == "done":
                    finished = action
                    break
                if do == "wait":
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    results.append("waited two seconds")
                    continue
                if do in self.extra:
                    try:
                        results.append(await self.extra[do](action))
                    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                        results.append(f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}")
                    continue
                if moved:
                    results.append(f'skipped {json.dumps(action, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]}: the page changed, its ids are stale')
                    continue
                before = self.tab.page.url
                try:
                    result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result = f"{do} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s and was stopped; the page may be stuck"
                except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
                    result = f"{do} failed: {str(error)[:200]}"
                results.append(result)
                if do in ("collect", "fetch"):
                    self.held = (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
                elif do in NAVIGATING:
                    self.held = None
                if do in NAVIGATING or self.tab.page.url != before or not await self._alive():
                    moved = True
            self.log(f"(read {read_s:.1f}s, model {model_s:.1f}s, act {time.time() - clock:.1f}s) {thought} | "
                     f"{json.dumps(actions, ensure_ascii=False)[:400]} | " + " ; ".join(r[:160] for r in results))
            if repeats >= 2:
                results.append("You have sent the same actions three times with the same result: they do not work "
                               "here. Read the page again from the top for another way (a further check, a toggle, a "
                               "different link, a search), or finish with done.")
            if finished is not None:
                outcome.update(summary=str(finished.get("summary", "")), answer=finished.get("answer"))
                news = await self.idle("done") if self.idle else None
                if news is None:
                    outcome["done"] = True
                    break
                results.append(news)
        outcome["steps"] = self.steps
        return outcome

def _int(value) -> int | None:
    number = parse_number(value)
    return int(number) if number is not None else None


def _text(value) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    return text if text and text.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a", "-", "—") else None


def _merge(store: dict, key, record: dict) -> None:
    old = store.setdefault(key, {})
    for name, value in record.items():
        if value is not None and value != "" and value != []:
            old[name] = value


class CaseFile:
    def __init__(self, brief: str, context: dict):
        self.brief = brief
        self.reference = _text(context.get("tender_reference")) or ""
        self.scenario = parse_when(context.get("scenario_date")) or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        self.company = _text(context.get("company_name")) or ""
        self.vat_id = _text(context.get("vat_id")) or ""
        senders = context.get("authorized_senders") or {}
        self.senders = {topic: (_text(senders.get(topic)) or "").split("@")[0].lower() for topic in TOPICS}
        self.mailbox: str | None = None
        self.positions: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.clarifications: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.revisions: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.requirements: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
        self.materials: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.conditions: dict[str, dict[tuple, dict]] = {}
        self.messages: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        self.answers: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}  # question id -> (complete | absent, note)
        self.filed: set[str] = set()
        self.news: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self.pending = 0
        self.version = 0
        self._changed = asyncio.Event()

    # ---- filing evidence -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _bump(self) -> None:
        self.version += 1
        self._changed.set()

    async def wait_change(self, seen: int, timeout: float) -> bool:
        """True once the case file has moved past version `seen`."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        end = loop.time() + timeout
        while self.version == seen:
            self._changed.clear()
            left = end - loop.time()
            if left <= 0:
                return False
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._changed.wait(), timeout=left)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                return False
        return True

    def take_news(self, agent: str) -> list[str]:
        return self.news.pop(agent, [])

    def file(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str) -> str:
        """File a document an agent chose; the extraction runs in the background and reports back as news."""
        if kind not in SHAPES:
            return f'unknown kind "{kind}"; the kinds are: {", ".join(SHAPES)}'
        if len(text.strip()) < 20:
            return "there is no document to file"
        # The pages of a collected list are read side by side: shorter replies, sooner.
        pages = [page for page in re.split(re.escape(PAGE_BREAK) + r" \d+ =====\n", text) if len(page.strip()) >= 20]
        folder = os.environ.get("AGENT_DOCS_DIR")
        if folder:
            os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
        fresh = 0
        for page in pages:
            digest = hashlib.sha1((kind + "\n" + page).encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
            if digest in self.filed:
                continue
            self.filed.add(digest)
            self.pending += 1
            fresh += 1
            if folder:  # local tuning only: preserve the exact evidence that was filed, one page per file
                filename = f"{len(self.filed):03d}-{kind}-{digest[:8]}.json"
                with open(os.path.join(folder, filename), "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
                    json.dump({"kind": kind, "source": source, "agent": agent, "text": page}, out,
                              ensure_ascii=False)
            asyncio.ensure_future(self._extract(kind, page, source, agent, digest))
        if not fresh:
            return f"this document is already filed as {kind}"
        return (f"filed {len(text)} characters ({fresh} page(s)) from {source} as {kind}; the facts in it will be "
                "reported to you")

    async def _extract(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str, digest: str = "") -> None:

class _Text(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.parts, self.skip = [], 0

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("script", "style"):
            self.skip += 1
        elif tag in ("p", "div", "tr", "br", "li", "h1", "h2", "h3", "table"):
            self.parts.append("\n")
        elif tag in ("td", "th"):
            self.parts.append(" | ")

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("script", "style") and self.skip:
            self.skip -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.skip:
            self.parts.append(data)


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[​-‏⁠-⁤﻿­͏؜᠎]", "", text)
    return re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", re.sub(r"[  ]+", " ", text)).strip()


def without_ids(text: str) -> str:
    """A document for reading only: the element ids of the pages it came from are gone by now."""
    return re.sub(r"\[\d+\] (?=(?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?[a-z-]+(?:\([a-z]+\))? \")", "", text)


def document_text(data: bytes, content_type: str, name: str, depth: int = 0) -> str:
    """The text of a fetched file: archives are opened, markup is stripped, PDFs are read when pypdf is installed."""
    kind = (content_type or "").lower()
    lower = name.lower()
    if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" or "zip" in kind or lower.endswith(".zip"):
        try:
            archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            return "(unreadable archive)"
        parts = [f"ARCHIVE {name} with files: " + ", ".join(info.filename for info in archive.infolist())]
        for info in archive.infolist()[:40]:
            if info.is_dir() or depth > 2:
                continue
            parts.append(f"=== FILE {info.filename} ===\n" + document_text(archive.read(info), "", info.filename, depth + 1))
        return "\n".join(parts)
    if data[:5] == b"%PDF-" or "pdf" in kind:
        try:
            from pypdf import PdfReader
            return clean_text("\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data)).pages))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"(PDF could not be read: {error})"
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if "html" in kind or "xml" in kind or re.search(r"<(html|body|table|div|p|w:document|worksheet)\b", text[:4000], re.I):
        parser = _Text()
        parser.feed(text)
        text = "".join(parser.parts)
    return clean_text(text)

class Script:
    """Stands in for llm.chat_json: answers each agent, named by `label`, with its next scripted reply."""

    def __init__(self, **replies):
        self.replies, self.asked = replies, []

    async def __call__(self, messages, *, think=True, max_tokens=6000, label=""):
        self.asked.append({"label": label, "think": think, "system": messages[0]["content"],
                           "user": messages[-1]["content"]})
        return self.replies[label].pop(0) if self.replies.get(label) else {}

    def turns(self, label: str) -> list[dict]:
        return [call for call in self.asked if call["label"] == label]


def done(**fields) -> dict:

class Control(NamedTuple):
    """One numbered control of an observation; `text` is everything the observation says about it."""
    id: int
    kind: str
    name: str
    text: str


CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\](?: \(in collapsed menu\))? ([a-z-]+)(?:\([a-z-]+\))? "([^"]*)"')


def controls(observation: str) -> list[Control]:
    found = []
    for line in observation.splitlines():
        marks = list(CONTROL.finditer(line))
        for mark, following in zip(marks, marks[1:] + [None]):
            found.append(Control(int(mark[1]), mark[2], mark[3], line[mark.start():following.start() if following else None]))

The calculator has fixed every number. `submit_bid` hands them to a model as a bid sheet and lets it drive whatever
bid form the portal has: where the form is, what each step wants, which notation a field takes, how a position is

  declining, and still sign and submit it.
- "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.
- "material" describes the offered product, for forms that make you pick or configure it: choose what equals
  these values.
- Amounts are net EUR, written here with a decimal point and without thousands separators. A field may expect
  another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.

- "omitted_positions" could not be priced. Never invent values for them: use the form's explicit way of leaving
  a position out, if it has one.

  from the bidder data and the bid sheet. Fill every field the sheet has a value for, optional ones included.

def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
    """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
    positions = []
    for line in bid.lines:
        material = line.material
        positions.append({
            "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
            "material": None if material is None else {
                "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
            "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
            "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
            "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
    discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
    return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",

        if codes:

class FixtureSite:

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests: list[tuple[str, str, dict]] = []  # (method, path with query, form fields), in order
        self.sessions: dict[str, str] = {}  # session cookie -> user name

            def log_message(self, *args):

                site.answer(self, {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True).items()})

    def paths(self) -> list[str]:
        return [path for _, path, _ in self.requests]

        """The fields of the last form posted to `path`."""
        return next((form for method, at, form in reversed(self.requests) if method == "POST" and at == path), None)

    def answer(self, request, form: dict) -> None:
        if request.path == "/favicon.ico":  # the browser's own idea, not a step of the tab
            return self.send(request, 404, "", TYPES[".txt"])
        self.requests.append((request.command, request.path, form))
        url = urlsplit(request.path)
        query = {key: values[-1] for key, values in parse_qs(url.query, keep_blank_values=True).items()}
        cookie = re.search(r"session=(\w+)", request.headers.get("cookie") or "")
        user = self.sessions.get(cookie[1]) if cookie else None
        path = url.path
        if path.startswith("/slow/"):
            time.sleep(self.DELAY)
            path = path[len("/slow"):]
        if path.startswith("/private/"):

                return self.send(request, 403, "Sign in first.", TYPES[".txt"])
            path = path[len("/private"):]

                                                     message='<p role="alert">Sign-in failed.</p>'))
        if path == "/login":
            return self.send(request, 200, self.page("login.html", ticket=self.ticket, message=""))

            rows = self.LATER_MESSAGES[after]
            following = after + len(rows)
            body = {"rows": rows, "next": f"/more-messages?after={following}" if following in self.LATER_MESSAGES else None}
            return self.send(request, 200, json.dumps(body), "application/json")

            return self.send(request, 200, f"<!doctype html><title>Received</title><h1>Received</h1><dl>{fields}</dl>")
        if path.startswith("/arrived/"):
            name = html.escape(path[len("/arrived/"):])
            return self.send(request, 200, f"<!doctype html><title>{name}</title><h1>You arrived at {name}</h1>")
        if path == "/bundle.zip":
            data = io.BytesIO()

        file = (FIXTURES / path.lstrip("/")).resolve()
        if FIXTURES in file.parents and file.is_file():
            return self.send(request, 200, file.read_bytes(), TYPES.get(file.suffix, "application/octet-stream"))
        return self.send(request, 404, "Not found.", TYPES[".txt"])

    def page(self, name: str, **values) -> str:
        return Template((FIXTURES / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")).substitute(values)

    def orders(self, number: int) -> str:
        pages = -(-len(self.ORDERS) // self.PER_PAGE)
        shown = self.ORDERS[(number - 1) * self.PER_PAGE:number * self.PER_PAGE]
        rows = "\n".join(f"  <tr><td>Order {order}</td><td>{item}</td><td>{quantity}</td></tr>"
                         for order, item, quantity in shown)
        previous = f'<a href="/orders?page={number - 1}">Previous page</a>' if number > 1 else ""
        following = f'<a href="/orders?page={number + 1}">Next page</a>' if number < pages else ""
        return self.page("paged_list.html", page=number, pages=pages, rows=rows, previous=previous, next=following)

    @staticmethod
    def send(request, status: int, body, content_type: str = TYPES[".html"], headers: dict | None = None) -> None:
        data = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body
        request.send_response(status)
        request.send_header("content-type", content_type)
        request.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        request.send_header("cache-control", "no-store")
        for name, value in (headers or {}).items():
            request.send_header(name, value)
        try:
            request.end_headers()
            request.wfile.write(data)
        except ConnectionError:  # the browser closed the tab before the answer was out
            pass

def setUpModule():
    """One server, one event loop and one Chromium for the whole module: a browser per test would take longer than
    the tests. The Playwright driver starts here with the real environment (on Windows it needs SystemRoot, which
    test_kit's entry-point tests clear for the length of a test)."""
    global SITE, LOOP, PLAYWRIGHT, BROWSER
    SITE = FixtureSite()
    LOOP = asyncio.new_event_loop()
    PLAYWRIGHT = LOOP.run_until_complete(async_playwright().start())
    BROWSER = LOOP.run_until_complete(PLAYWRIGHT.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS", "1") != "0"))


def tearDownModule():
    LOOP.run_until_complete(BROWSER.close())
    LOOP.run_until_complete(PLAYWRIGHT.stop())
    LOOP.close()
    SITE.close()
    READ.clear()


def on_the_loop(test):
    @functools.wraps(test)
    def run(self):
        LOOP.run_until_complete(asyncio.wait_for(test(self), 40))  # a hung action fails its test, not the suite
    return run


class Control(NamedTuple):
    """One numbered control of an observation; `text` is everything the observation says about it."""
    id: int
    kind: str
    name: str
    text: str


CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\](?: \(in collapsed menu\))? ([a-z-]+)(?:\([a-z-]+\))? "([^"]*)"')


def controls(observation: str) -> list[Control]:
    found = []
    for line in observation.splitlines():
        marks = list(CONTROL.finditer(line))
        for mark, following in zip(marks, marks[1:] + [None]):
            found.append(Control(int(mark[1]), mark[2], mark[3], line[mark.start():following.start() if following else None]))
    return found


class Case(unittest.TestCase):
    """A test is a coroutine on the module's loop. `open` gives it a tab of its own, with fresh cookies, on a
    fixture; `read` the observation of a fixture nobody acts on."""
    maxDiff = None

    def __init_subclass__(cls, **kwargs):
        super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs)
        for name, test in list(vars(cls).items()):
            if name.startswith("test") and inspect.iscoroutinefunction(test):
                setattr(cls, name, on_the_loop(test))

    async def open(self, path: str, credentials: dict | None = None) -> Tab:
        context = await BROWSER.new_context()
        self.addCleanup(lambda: LOOP.run_until_complete(context.close()))
        tab = Tab(await context.new_page(), {"siteId": "fixture", "url": SITE.url + "/", "credentials": credentials})
        SITE.requests.clear()
        await tab.goto(path)
        return tab

    async def read(self, path: str) -> str:
        if path not in READ:
            READ[path] = await (await self.open(path)).observe()

{brief}

{bidder}

{sheet}

- "positions" has one entry per tender position that is offered. Enter each under its own position number.
- "material" describes the offered product, for forms that make you pick or configure it: choose what equals

- Amounts are net EUR, written here with a decimal point and without thousands separators. A field may expect
  another notation (a decimal comma, a unit, whole numbers for weeks and pieces): follow its hints, placeholder
  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.

def on_the_loop(test):
    @functools.wraps(test)
    def run(self):
        LOOP.run_until_complete(asyncio.wait_for(test(self), 40))  # a hung action fails its test, not the suite
    return run


class Control(NamedTuple):
    """One numbered control of an observation; `text` is everything the observation says about it."""
    id: int
    kind: str
    name: str
    text: str


CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\](?: \(in collapsed menu\))? ([a-z-]+)(?:\([a-z-]+\))? "([^"]*)"')


def controls(observation: str) -> list[Control]:
    found = []
    for line in observation.splitlines():
        marks = list(CONTROL.finditer(line))
        for mark, following in zip(marks, marks[1:] + [None]):
            found.append(Control(int(mark[1]), mark[2], mark[3], line[mark.start():following.start() if following else None]))
    return found

def final_quantities(positions: list[Position], answers: list[Clarification],
                     requirements: dict[str, Requirement]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[str]]:
    """Each position's quantity in pieces: the tender's, replaced by the latest answer that changes it, sets
    converted with the requirement's pieces per set. Also the positions whose set size is unknown."""
    raw = {p.position: (p.quantity, p.is_set) for p in positions}
    for answer in answers:
        for position, quantity, is_set in answer.quantity_changes:
            if position in raw:
                raw[position] = (quantity, raw[position][1] if is_set is None else is_set)
    pieces, unknown = {}, []
    for p in positions:
        quantity, is_set = raw[p.position]
        if is_set:
            need = requirements.get(p.requirement_ref)
            if need is None or not need.pieces_per_set:
                unknown.append(p.position)
                continue
            quantity *= need.pieces_per_set
        pieces[p.position] = quantity
    return pieces, unknown

"""A conservative, no-model checklist for the tender portal's review page.

The clerk decides when it has reached a review page.  This module only reports
what the accessible page proves and blocks finalisation on explicit errors or
unfilled required controls; it never invents portal-specific field mappings.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid

ERROR = re.compile(r"\b(error|invalid|failed|missing|fehler|ungültig|pflichtfeld)\b", re.I)
EMPTY_REQUIRED = re.compile(r"^(?=.*\(required\))(?=.*(?:value=\"\"|\[unchecked\])).*$", re.I)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Report:
    ready: bool
    blockers: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
    checks: tuple[str, ...]

    def text(self) -> str:
        state = "READY" if self.ready else "BLOCKED"
        lines = [f"PRE-SUBMISSION CHECKLIST: {state}", *[f"- {item}" for item in self.checks]]
        lines += [f"- BLOCKER: {item}" for item in self.blockers]
        lines += [f"- WARNING: {item}" for item in self.warnings]
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _money(value: Decimal) -> set[str]:
    fixed = f"{value:.2f}"
    whole, cents = fixed.split(".")
    return {fixed, fixed.replace(".", ","), f"{int(whole):,}.{cents}", f"{int(whole):,}".replace(",", ".") + "," + cents}


def check(page: str, bid: Bid, reference: str) -> Report:
    """Report review-page evidence without assuming a portal's labels or layout."""
    visible = re.sub(r"\[\d+\] ", "", page)
    lower = visible.lower()
    blockers: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    checks: list[str] = []
    errors = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if ERROR.search(line)]
    required = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if EMPTY_REQUIRED.match(line)]
    if errors:
        blockers.append("the portal reports: " + " | ".join(errors[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no explicit portal error is visible")
    if required:
        blockers.append("a required control is empty or unchecked: " + " | ".join(required[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no empty required control is visible")
    if reference and reference.lower() in lower:
        checks.append(f"tender reference {reference} is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append(f"tender reference {reference} is not visible on this page")
    expected = [line.position for line in bid.lines]
    missing = [position for position in expected if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.-]){re.escape(position)}(?![\w.-])", visible)]
    if missing:
        warnings.append("offered position(s) not visible in this review: " + ", ".join(missing))
    else:
        checks.append("every offered position is visible")
    amounts = _money(Decimal(bid.total_net))
    if any(amount in visible for amount in amounts):
        checks.append("calculated total is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append("calculated total is not visible on this page")
    return Report(not blockers, tuple(blockers), tuple(warnings), tuple(checks))

async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
                     deadline: float) -> dict:
    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).

    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
    """
    reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
    codes: list[str] = []  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again

    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
        task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
        if not task:
            return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
        if mail_tab is None:
            return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"

        def request() -> str:
            text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
            if codes:
                text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
                         "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
            return text

        system = COURIER.format(site=mail_tab.site_id, url=mail_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
                                actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
        courier = Agent("courier", mail_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
                        max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS)
        outcome = await courier.run()
        answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
        if not answer:
            return "the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
        codes.append(answer)
        return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")

    def heading() -> str:
        left = int(deadline - time.time())
        text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
        if codes:
            text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
        if left < WRAP_UP:
            text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
                     "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
        return text

    bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
    system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
                          bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
                          sheet=json.dumps(bid_sheet(bid), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
    clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading, extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS)
    outcome = await clerk.run()
    receipt = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
    notes = str(outcome.get("summary") or "")
    if not outcome.get("done"):
        notes = (notes + " " if notes else "") + f"stopped after {outcome.get('steps', 0)} steps without a confirmation"
    return {"submitted": bool(outcome.get("done") and receipt), "receipt": receipt, "notes": notes}

"""Evidence provenance remains attached to the extracted facts it produced."""
import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import casefile  # noqa: E402
import llm  # noqa: E402


class EvidenceProvenance(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_successful_extraction_records_its_source_and_typed_result(self):
        facts = casefile.CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "TEST-0001", "scenario_date": "2030-01-01"})

        async def extracted(*args, **kwargs):
            return {"positions": [{"position": "1", "quantity": 4, "requirement_ref": "REQ-1"}]}

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", extracted):
            await facts._extract("positions", "Position 1: four items", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender", "abc123")
        [evidence] = facts.evidence
        self.assertEqual((evidence["id"], evidence["kind"], evidence["source"], evidence["agent"]),
                         ("abc123", "positions", "https://portal.example/rfq", "tender"))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["extracted"]["positions"][0]["position"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(facts.dump())["evidence"][0]["source"], "https://portal.example/rfq")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Synthetic review-page variations for the last, non-submitting portal check."""
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid, Line
from preflight import check


def bid() -> Bid:
    line = Line("1", "M-1", 40, unit_price=Decimal("12.50"), lead_time_weeks=3)
    return Bid("T-0001", "bid", Decimal("2.5"), [line], Decimal("500.00"))


class ReviewPages(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_renamed_and_reordered_review_fields_still_pass(self):
        page = "Bestellübersicht\nEUR 500,00\nArtikel 1 / M-1\nVorgang T-0001\n[8] button \"Endgültig bestätigen\""
        report = check(page, bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertTrue(report.ready, report.text())

    def test_visible_validation_error_and_required_input_block_finalisation(self):
        page = ('T-0001\nPosition 1\nTotal 500.00\n'
                '[3] input "VAT ID" value="" (required)\n(error) Please complete highlighted fields')
        report = check(page, bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertFalse(report.ready)
        self.assertEqual(len(report.blockers), 2)

    def test_absent_summary_values_warn_without_guessing_a_failure(self):
        report = check('[9] button "Continue"', bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertTrue(report.ready)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(report.warnings), 3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

All agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.

You can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent without triggering a turn.
Child agents can also spawn their own sub-agents.
You can decide how much context you want to propagate to your sub-agents with the `fork_turns` parameter.

You will receive messages in the analysis channel in the form:
```
Message Type: MESSAGE | FINAL_ANSWER
Task name: <recipient>
Sender: <author>
Payload:
<payload text>
```
They may be addressed as to=/root

Note that collaboration tools cannot be called from inside `functions.exec`. Call `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and `list_agents` only as direct tool calls using the recipient shown in their tool definitions, such as `to=functions.collaboration.spawn_agent`, since they are intentionally absent from the `functions.exec` `tools.*` namespace. Available tools in `functions.exec` are explicitly described with a `tools` namespace in the developer message.

All agents share the same directory. In detail:
- All agents have access to the same container and filesystem as you.
- All agents use the same current working directory.
- As a result, edits made by one agent are immediately visible to all other agents.

When calling `wait_agent`, prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.

There are 4 available concurrency slots, meaning that up to 4 agents can be active at once, including you.

Full-history forks (`fork_turns` omitted or `"all"`) inherit the parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. Only set `model` or `reasoning_effort` when explicitly requested by the user, applicable `AGENTS.md` instructions, or skill instructions; when doing so, set `fork_turns` to `"none"` or a positive integer string.

"""A conservative, no-model checklist for the tender portal's review page.

The clerk decides when it has reached a review page.  This module only reports
what the accessible page proves and blocks finalisation on explicit errors or
unfilled required controls; it never invents portal-specific field mappings.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid

ERROR = re.compile(r"\b(error|invalid|failed|missing|fehler|ungültig|pflichtfeld)\b", re.I)
EMPTY_REQUIRED = re.compile(r"^(?=.*\(required\))(?=.*(?:value=\"\"|\[unchecked\])).*$", re.I)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Report:
    ready: bool
    blockers: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
    checks: tuple[str, ...]

    def text(self) -> str:
        state = "READY" if self.ready else "BLOCKED"
        lines = [f"PRE-SUBMISSION CHECKLIST: {state}", *[f"- {item}" for item in self.checks]]
        lines += [f"- BLOCKER: {item}" for item in self.blockers]
        lines += [f"- WARNING: {item}" for item in self.warnings]
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _money(value: Decimal) -> set[str]:
    fixed = f"{value:.2f}"
    whole, cents = fixed.split(".")
    return {fixed, fixed.replace(".", ","), f"{int(whole):,}.{cents}", f"{int(whole):,}".replace(",", ".") + "," + cents}


def check(page: str, bid: Bid, reference: str) -> Report:
    """Report review-page evidence without assuming a portal's labels or layout."""
    visible = re.sub(r"\[\d+\] ", "", page)
    lower = visible.lower()
    blockers: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    checks: list[str] = []
    errors = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if ERROR.search(line)]
    required = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if EMPTY_REQUIRED.match(line)]
    if errors:
        blockers.append("the portal reports: " + " | ".join(errors[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no explicit portal error is visible")
    if required:
        blockers.append("a required control is empty or unchecked: " + " | ".join(required[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no empty required control is visible")
    if reference and reference.lower() in lower:
        checks.append(f"tender reference {reference} is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append(f"tender reference {reference} is not visible on this page")
    expected = [line.position for line in bid.lines]
    missing = [position for position in expected if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.-]){re.escape(position)}(?![\w.-])", visible)]
    if missing:
        warnings.append("offered position(s) not visible in this review: " + ", ".join(missing))
    else:
        checks.append("every offered position is visible")
    amounts = _money(Decimal(bid.total_net))
    if any(amount in visible for amount in amounts):
        checks.append("calculated total is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append("calculated total is not visible on this page")
    return Report(not blockers, tuple(blockers), tuple(warnings), tuple(checks))
"""Synthetic review-page variations for the last, non-submitting portal check."""
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid, Line
from preflight import check


def bid() -> Bid:
    line = Line("1", "M-1", 40, unit_price=Decimal("12.50"), lead_time_weeks=3)
    return Bid("T-0001", "bid", Decimal("2.5"), [line], Decimal("500.00"))


class ReviewPages(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_renamed_and_reordered_review_fields_still_pass(self):
        page = "Bestellübersicht\nEUR 500,00\nArtikel 1 / M-1\nVorgang T-0001\n[8] button \"Endgültig bestätigen\""
        report = check(page, bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertTrue(report.ready, report.text())

    def test_visible_validation_error_and_required_input_block_finalisation(self):
        page = ('T-0001\nPosition 1\nTotal 500.00\n'
                '[3] input "VAT ID" value="" (required)\n(error) Please complete highlighted fields')
        report = check(page, bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertFalse(report.ready)
        self.assertEqual(len(report.blockers), 2)

    def test_absent_summary_values_warn_without_guessing_a_failure(self):
        report = check('[9] button "Continue"', bid(), "T-0001")
        self.assertTrue(report.ready)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(report.warnings), 3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""A conservative, no-model checklist for the tender portal's review page.

The clerk decides when it has reached a review page.  This module only reports
what the accessible page proves and blocks finalisation on explicit errors or
unfilled required controls; it never invents portal-specific field mappings.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from calculator import Bid

ERROR = re.compile(r"\b(error|invalid|failed|missing|fehler|ungültig|pflichtfeld)\b", re.I)
EMPTY_REQUIRED = re.compile(r"^(?=.*\(required\))(?=.*(?:value=\"\"|\[unchecked\])).*$", re.I)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Report:
    ready: bool
    blockers: tuple[str, ...]
    warnings: tuple[str, ...]
    checks: tuple[str, ...]

    def text(self) -> str:
        state = "READY" if self.ready else "BLOCKED"
        lines = [f"PRE-SUBMISSION CHECKLIST: {state}", *[f"- {item}" for item in self.checks]]
        lines += [f"- BLOCKER: {item}" for item in self.blockers]
        lines += [f"- WARNING: {item}" for item in self.warnings]
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _money(value: Decimal) -> set[str]:
    fixed = f"{value:.2f}"
    whole, cents = fixed.split(".")
    return {fixed, fixed.replace(".", ","), f"{int(whole):,}.{cents}", f"{int(whole):,}".replace(",", ".") + "," + cents}


def check(page: str, bid: Bid, reference: str) -> Report:
    """Report review-page evidence without assuming a portal's labels or layout."""
    visible = re.sub(r"\[\d+\] ", "", page)
    lower = visible.lower()
    blockers: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    checks: list[str] = []
    errors = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if ERROR.search(line)]
    required = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if EMPTY_REQUIRED.match(line)]
    if errors:
        blockers.append("the portal reports: " + " | ".join(errors[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no explicit portal error is visible")
    if required:
        blockers.append("a required control is empty or unchecked: " + " | ".join(required[:3])[:500])
    else:
        checks.append("no empty required control is visible")
    if reference and reference.lower() in lower:
        checks.append(f"tender reference {reference} is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append(f"tender reference {reference} is not visible on this page")
    expected = [line.position for line in bid.lines]
    missing = [position for position in expected if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.-]){re.escape(position)}(?![\w.-])", visible)]
    if missing:
        warnings.append("offered position(s) not visible in this review: " + ", ".join(missing))
    else:
        checks.append("every offered position is visible")
    amounts = _money(Decimal(bid.total_net))
    if any(amount in visible for amount in amounts):
        checks.append("calculated total is visible")
    else:
        warnings.append("calculated total is not visible on this page")
    return Report(not blockers, tuple(blockers), tuple(warnings), tuple(checks))
